items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: The interviewee does not mention George Washington; the term is only used by the interviewer in a story about playing with Claude Williams and Lester Young.

ctx.x: Oh definitely not. It was called The Cajun Restaurant. And I still have like some videos on those old cassettes — videocassettes, that we made. I mean Doc had his own language. He had his own vocabulary. He would say, “Well I dig your ground pads.” That meant he liked your shoes. And he would call everyone Jack when he was telling a tale. “That’s the way it goes, Jack.”

I love that. I got to play once with Claude “Fiddler” Williams. And we were in the middle of a tune and he goes, we’re coming near the end and he goes, “George Washington.” “What?” And then so I went to the bridge, so I go, “Oh, George Washington.”
